name: knowledge
description: Searches YouTrack articles and your local folders together as one knowledge base.

ollama_url.title: Ollama URL (default http://127.0.0.1:11434)
ollama_url.description: Ollama server used for embeddings; http or https, no credentials

embed_model.title: Embedding model (default bge-m3)
embed_model.description: Ollama embedding model name; it must be pulled in Ollama

folders.title: Local folders to index (absolute paths, comma or newline separated)
folders.description: Only these folders are scanned; relative paths are refused

extensions.title: File extensions to index in folders (comma separated, e.g. md,txt; default: common text and code files)
extensions.description: Replaces the default list of text and code extensions

youtrack_base_url.title: YouTrack server URL (for articles)
youtrack_base_url.description: e.g. https://youtrack.example.com (no credentials in the URL); needs YOUTRACK_TOKEN too

youtrack_token.title: YouTrack permanent token
youtrack_token.description: Sent only to YOUTRACK_BASE_URL as Authorization: Bearer

zh.description: 把 YouTrack 文章和本机文件夹合成一个知识库来搜索。
